patterns.note: Asymmetric full-screen sections with a single dominant visual element (e.g., large typography, 3D image cube) balanced by small, detailed text elements in the corners.
Extreme contrast in type scale, featuring monumental, bold, wide sans-serif display text that often serves as a primary graphic element, juxtaposed with very small, fine-print sans-serif body text.
A high-contrast, limited color palette primarily using deep black, stark white, and a single vibrant orange as an accent and background for full-screen sections.

The initial hero features a large 'FW' and a list of works that remain sticky or parallax very slowly, while a dynamic 3D image cube animates into view and continuously rotates over the 'W' as the user scrolls. Subsequent sections transition by changing the full-screen background color and revealing oversized, single-word titles that slide up from the bottom of the viewport.
Full-bleed, distinct sections that occupy the entire viewport, each introduced by a dramatic background color change and a large, single-word title.

technique_notes: The site uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate complex scroll-based animations. Key elements like the large initial text and navigation list are pinned or given a very slow parallax effect, maintaining their presence while other elements animate. A 3D image cube is revealed and set into continuous rotation upon scroll. Full-screen sections are implemented with viewport-height containers, where scrolling triggers a background color change and a large text element to slide into view from the bottom, creating a dramatic, sequential reveal of content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, wide display headings (~8-10x body text) are used as primary visual elements, contrasting sharply with very small, fine-print body and navigational text.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with extensive use of negative space, especially in hero and section introductions, creating a minimalist and impactful presentation.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its audacious use of monumental, architectural typography as primary visual elements, combined with a highly interactive and persistent initial hero section featuring a rotating 3D image cube. The stark, high-contrast color palette and full-screen section transitions create a dramatic and memorable user experience.
